verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
All heaven declares
the glory of the risen Lord

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Who can compare
with the beauty of the Lord

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Forever He will be
The Lamb upon the throne

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I gladly bow the knee
And worship Him alone

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I will proclaim
the glory of the risen Lord

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Who once was slain
to reconcile man to God
